messages.content:
You are grading an AI assistant's answer to a question about a company handbook.

Question: If I move from GitLab LTD (UK) to GitLab Ireland Ltd, how will my pension contribution rates and employer matching change?
Reference answer (written from the handbook): In the UK you contribute 5% of basic salary with a 4% employer match, while in Ireland you contribute 3% with GitLab matching up to 5% of annual base salary.

Passages the assistant was given:
"""
[GitLab Ireland Ltd > We've Got You Covered > Financial Security > Pension Plan]
- New hires are automatically enrolled under the Aviva plan, with a 3% Employee and Employer contribution
- Team members can increase their contribution and GitLab matches up to 5% of annual base salary
- Option for team members to make Additional Voluntary Contributions (AVCs)
- Professional administration through NFP Ireland
- Transfers accepted from other pension plans  
- See the [Pension information video](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1i5ir2xMWMIQznq-tEGCmTkSfZ_GuuV46ARlKhAGYrS0/edit)

How to Enroll or Change Your Contributions

1. Complete and submit the [Aviva Pension Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScdCoeWdGTGpiucDaY5nxIhiMKGd3JJBoynKTwNCbAueMsRnQ/viewform?usp=sharing) with your details

Important Details & Resources

- Enrollments after the 7th process the following month
- Review investments through Aviva's Fund Centre
- [New joiner FAQ](https://drive.google.com/file/d/10VEGE29XqHfCpM-axOXrW2vpmBgL3umn/view?usp=sharing)
- [Leaver options guide](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1GJpVSKGanT6xNg9wfKAd20N2trVjCGL5/view?usp=sharing)

Contact Details

- Email: employeebenefits@nfpireland.ie
- Phone: +353 1 210 0210

[GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Financial Security > Pension Scheme]
- From April 6, 2019 to a minimum of:
  - Team Member: 5% of basic salary
  - GitLab: 4% of basic salary

- As your contribution is a percentage of your pay, the amounts will automatically increase or decrease in accordance with your basic pay. These contributions will be taken from your pay and will include tax relief.

- You may increase your contribution percentage by contacting the Non-US Payroll team via [Compass](https://app.serval.com/new-request). The company contribution will remain fixed as outlined above. The standard **Annual Allowance** applies to all contributions (employer and employee) made to the pension plan in a tax year. Unused allowance may be carried forward for up to three tax years. Current rates are published on the [HMRC Pension Schemes rates page](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/rates-and-allowances-pension-schemes/pension-schemes-rates). Your Annual Allowance may be reduced if your Adjusted Income exceeds the threshold limit (current rates available on the [HMRC Pension Schemes rates page](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/rates-and-allowances-pension-schemes/pension-schemes-rates)), or if you 'flexibly access' benefits from a Defined Contribution pension arrangement. See the [Annual Allowance Fact Sheet](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1MMA-0wfzUsO70pBsweDAHK-FVc-P_iR1/view?usp=sharing) for details.

[GitLab Ireland Ltd > We've Got You Covered > Financial Security > Pension Plan]
GitLab offers a defined contribution pension scheme through Aviva, administered by NFP Ireland, designed to help you build financial security for retirement. Effective 2025-11-01, all new hires will be automatically enrolled under our company plan.

 NEW (January 2026) - Pension Auto Enrolment Regulation 

- Starting January 1, 2026, Ireland's new Auto Enrolment pension scheme (called "My Future Fund") becomes mandatory. All eligible employees who are not already contributing to a workplace pension scheme will be automatically enrolled in this government-run pension program.
- **Opportunity**: Team Members can join our superior company DC pension plan and avoid being automatically enrolled in the less beneficial government scheme.
- **Key Advantages of our Company Plan**: 3-5% employer matching contribution (compared to 1.5% employer contribution in Auto Enrolment's first phase), complete contribution flexibility, income tax relief, flexible investment options and no mandatory waiting periods.
- See the [Ireland Auto Enrolment Pension Transition FAQ](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1m2wG90cXvKGB7IK4IR22sbfp5GzTntZw/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=108025801343696146787&rtpof=true&sd=true) for detailed information

 GitLab Pension Scheme Coverage 

[GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Financial Security > Pension Scheme]
- **For Team Membewrs on Relief at Source Only**: These percentages are gross percentages using the [relief at source](https://www.gov.uk/workplace-pensions/managing-your-pension) method. As basic rate tax relief is then added by the pension provider, the amount on your payslip will typically be the net amount, which is 80% of the employee’s contribution.

These contribution percentages are in line with [The Pension Regulator’s Auto-enrollment legislation](https://www.thepensionsregulator.gov.uk/en/document-library/automatic-enrolment-detailed-guidance). Should the government’s minimum contribution standards change further GitLab will contact you to advise the new levels to comply with legislation.

Opting Out

If you decide to opt out of the scheme you can do this within one month of the enrollment date by following the instructions in the information from Scottish Widows. The Opt Out deadlines are:

[GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Financial Security > Pension Scheme]
GitLab provides a Group Personal Pension Plan with Scottish Widows, helping you build financial security for retirement.

Eligibility Requirements

Automatic enrollment if you:

- Earn over £10,000 annually
- Are aged 22 or over
- Are under State Pension Age

If an employee does not meet these criteria then they will be considered an Entitled Worker (earn less than £6,240 p.a) or a Non-Eligible Jobholder (earn between £6,240 and £10,000 p.a).

Entitled workers must be offered the opportunity to join the pension scheme. They can make contributions to the pension scheme if they choose. However, there is no requirement for GitLab to make a contribution.

Non-Eligible jobholders must be offered the opportunity to opt in to an automatic enrollment scheme.

 Coverage & Key Features

- GitLab contributes 4% of your basic salary
- You contribute 5% of your basic salary (minimum)
- Annual Management Charge: 0.54%
- Tax relief on your contributions (20-45% depending on tax band)
- Over 50 fund options available
- Salary sacrifice option available (saving on National Insurance)
- Watch the [2025 UK Pension Webinar](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ZUXJLK3v_m96yUUOpsNkX2Skh7ScdKuI/view) and review the [presentation](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1qXAIOTTMavV0pxbj6Hxm0y2k39MoJ6Rz/view) for an overview of the UK Pension System
- View the [Company Pension Plan FAQ](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1BEADGm7sUbroEkxzGvB-DBIhMIbbLG46/view?usp=sharing)

How to Enroll/Access

[GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Financial Security > Pension Scheme]
Salary Sacrifice

Save on National Insurance contributions while building your pension. Team members hired after 13 December 2022 are automatically enrolled. Earlier hires can opt in via [Compass](https://app.serval.com/new-request).

**Salary Sacrifice FAQ**

- Can we change the amount during the period we’re contracted for salary exchange?
  - Yes it is possible to change the amount/increase your employee percent

- What happens if our ‘actual’ salary changes during the period?
  - Your employee contribution is a percent of basic pay so if your basic pay increases the pension contribution will too.

- What happens if we receive a discretionary bonus?
  - Your definition of pensionable pay is basic salary the percent will not automatically be applied to the bonus. Should you wish to contribute part of you bonus to your pension pot you can do that.
- Is it possible to start from any month?
  - Yes it is; it would be processed on the next available payroll.

- My pension statements only show the Employer Contributions. Is it expected?
  - Yes it is; when pension contributions are made via Salary Sacrifice, both Employee and Employer contributions will show as Employer contributions on Scottish Widows statements.

Pension Contribution Percentages

The certification level that has been chosen is basic salary only and will not include commission, bonuses or any over time payments. The contributions will be paid monthly and will be shown on the pay-slips.
"""

Assistant's answer:
"""
In the UK, the minimum contributions are 5% from the employee and 4% from GitLab [2][5]. In Ireland, new hires are automatically enrolled with a 3% employee and 3% employer contribution, though GitLab matches employee contributions up to 5% of annual base salary [1][3]. Therefore, your employer match could increase from 4% to up to 5%, while your minimum employee contribution decreases from 5% to 3% [1][2][5].
"""

First write one sentence of reasoning, then grade three things:
- correctness: "correct" if the answer states the key information in the reference answer without contradicting it (extra correct detail is fine); "partial" if it gets part of it or is vague; "incorrect" if it is wrong, contradicts the reference, or does not answer.
- refused: true if the assistant declined or said it does not know, instead of answering.
- faithful: true if every factual claim in the answer is supported by the passages above (ignore whether it matches the reference). An answer that only refuses counts as faithful.
The grades must agree with your reasoning.
Return JSON with the reasoning first: {"reason": "one sentence", "correctness": "correct" | "partial" | "incorrect", "refused": true/false, "faithful": true/false}
